sources.snippet: Phishing remains a persistent cybersecurity threat that requires accurate and efficient detection methods. Existing approaches struggle to capture both fine-grained URL structures and broader contextual semantics, limiting their effectiveness. sources.title: ️ Phishing Website Detection using AI/ML - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🛡️ Phishing Website Detection using AI/ML This project implements a Random Forest-based Machine Learning model to detect phishing websites using URL-based features. It leverages a curated dataset of phishing and legitimate URLs, extracts features, and trains a classifier that achieves 96.8% accuracy.

sources.title: vishaaall360/AI_PHISING_URL_DETECTOR - GitHub
sources.snippet: A Machine Learning-based web application that detects whether a given URL is safe or phishing. The system analyzes URL-based features and classifies websites in real time using a trained ML model with a Flask web interface.

sources.title: New MessiahGPT AI Model Fueling Automated Ransomware and Phishing Attacks
sources.snippet: MessiahGPT is an uncensored AI service for generating ransomware, phishing kits, stealers, and other offensive tools.

sources.title: JadePuffer agentic attacks now target AI model data with ransomware
sources.snippet: The JadePuffer autonomous AI agent has upgraded with custom malware called EncForge that focuses on encrypting AI assets, such as training datasets, vector databases, and model checkpoints.
